ground.reason: The failure-path question asked of a killed build: SLS-A3 covers every kill point, but it asserts only on the state after a successful rebuild. SLS-A2 and SLS-A7 assert reports/ stays clean for their own failure modes, yet no criterion checks what reports/ contains in the interval between a kill and the next build. D2 promises a reader sees the old report or the new one, never part of one, and the purpose says finance must never find a partial or mixed report; a kill after the last row but before the atomic replace can leave a staged temp file in reports/, and nothing tests that it is absent or unreadable as a report.

objections.objection: The criteria let through an implementation whose killed build leaves a partial or temp file visible in reports/ until the next rebuild, so finance can find a stray partial artifact for that day, contradicting the stated purpose, with every criterion still passing.

scenario.given: an existing report for 2026-10-01 and the stub answering normally
scenario.when: a build for 2026-10-01 is killed after the last row is written but before the report is replaced, and no rebuild has run yet
scenario.expect: reports/ holds only the old report and no temp or partial file, which no criterion checks

rejected.objection: The criteria let through an implementation whose killed build leaves a partial or temp file visible in reports/ until the next rebuild, so finance can find a stray partial artifact for that day, contradicting the stated purpose, with every criterion still passing.
rejected.reason: SLS-A3 runs the case of a build killed after the last row but before the report was replaced, followed by a new build for that date, with the stated outcome that `reports/` holds the report and no other new file; SLS-A2 runs the write-failure case with the stated outcome that no other file appears in `reports/`. The objection's scenario is SLS-A3's killed build observed at an earlier moment, between the kill and the rebuild, which is a variant in timing of that case. The criteria fix the cases the check runs, so the objection is rejected.
